A Letter for Mummy 💌

Dear Mummy,

I don't always know how to say everything I feel, so I thought I would write it here.

First of all, I want you to know that I love you very much. ❤️

You are my Mummy, and no matter what happens in life, that will always be one of the most important relationships in my life.

I know sometimes I make mistakes. I know sometimes I don't understand things the way you do. I know you worry about me and want to protect me.

I may not always show it properly, but I notice your care.

I want to become someone you can be proud of.

I want to study well, build my career, become independent and make a good life for myself.

And I want you to be there to see all of it.

There are many things going on in my mind these days. Sometimes I feel confused, sometimes I feel hurt, and sometimes I just miss having someone to talk to.

But one thing I know for sure is that I need my Mummy.

I want more peaceful moments with you.

I want more laughs.

More talks.

More little memories.

More ice cream together. 🍦❤️

I don't want small misunderstandings to become bigger than our love for each other.

I just want us to understand each other better.

Thank you for being my Mummy.

Thank you for everything you have done for me, even for the things I don't always say thank you for.

I love you more than I can explain.

You will always be my Mummy. ❤️

With love,

Jiya 🫂

My Birthday Wishes For You 🌷

Happy Birthday, Mummy! 🎂❤️

May Allah bless you with a long, healthy, peaceful and beautiful life.

I pray that you always have reasons to smile and that every year brings you more happiness.

I hope all your worries become lighter and your heart stays peaceful.

I wish you happiness not just today, but every single day. I hope you get everything you wish for.

I hope we make many more beautiful memories together.

I hope we laugh together, go out together, eat our favourite things together and enjoy all the little moments that make life special.

You deserve lots of happiness, love and peace.

Thank you for being my Mummy and for everything you have done for me.

No matter how much I grow up, I will always be your daughter.

Happy Birthday once again, Mummy! 🎂🌷

May Allah always keep you safe, healthy and happy.

Lots of love, Jiya 🫂❤️

    A Letter from Future Jiya ✉️

    It travelled back in time, just for you.

    To: Mummy 💗
    from Future Jiya
    💗

    Tap the envelope to open it ✉️

    Somewhere in the future ✨

    My dearest Mummy,

    I'm writing this from the future, and I have the best news: I did it. All those late nights, all that worry, all those days I felt I wasn't enough — they turned into something real. I'm standing exactly where I once dreamed I would be.

    I have my own career now, my own name, and the independence I used to only whisper about. And do you know the very first thing I did with my first salary? I took you on a trip. We went back to the mountains, and this time we took a hundred photos together. 📸

    But Mummy, every success I have carries your fingerprints. Every wish you quietly put aside so mine could come true. Every meal you fed me before you ate. Every dua you made when I wasn't even listening. I see all of it now, and I'm sorry it took me so long to say thank you. I'll keep saying it for the rest of my life.

    I know I wasn't always easy. I argued, I sulked, and I didn't understand why you worried so much. Now I understand: it was never control, it was love — the kind that asks for nothing and gives everything. Thank you for loving me, even on the days I didn't deserve it.

    I promised I would make you proud, and I'm keeping that promise every single day. When people clap for me, I'm really clapping for you.

    And here is the one promise I will never break: no matter how successful I become, how busy my days get, or how far my work takes me — you will always be my first priority. Meetings can wait. Deadlines can wait. Mummy can't. ❤️

    When your hands get tired, I'll hold them, just like you held mine when I was learning to walk. You will never have to wonder where you stand in my life: right at the very top.

    Until then, keep smiling, keep being you, and wait for me in that future. I'm coming with so much to show you.

    Forever your little girl,
    Future Jiya 🫂

    P.S. The ice cream is on me. 🍦

    💗

    Tap the envelope to open it ✉️

    Dear Mummy,

    There is so much in my heart that I don’t always say out loud, so I’m letting this little card say it for me.

    Thank you for your care: in the meals, the reminders, the prayers, and the way you always notice when something is on my mind. I see it, and I’m grateful for every bit of it.

    You make our home feel warm and safe, and you’ve shown me what love looks like in the small, everyday things.

    I’m learning and growing, and I hope to make you proud. Wherever life takes me, I want you beside me, sharing the good days and the busy ones.

    I love you, Mummy. Always. 💗

    With all my love,
    Jiya 🫂

      A Letter I Couldn't Say Out Loud 💌

      Some words are easier to write than to say.

      To: Mummy 💌
      a letter I couldn’t say out loud
      💌

      Tap the envelope to open it ✉️

      Dear Mummy,

      Some things are easier to write than to say, so I’m giving them a little home here: the feelings I carry quietly in my heart.

      First, thank you. Not the quick kind I say in passing, but the deep kind. Thank you for every meal, every worry you carried so I could sleep, every prayer, and every small thing you did that I never stopped to thank you for.

      Sometimes the words get stuck on their way out. That never means the feeling isn’t there. It is always there, Mummy, bigger than I know how to explain.

      We won’t always see everything the same way, and that’s okay. What matters to me is that we keep talking, keep listening, and keep choosing each other. I truly believe our best conversations are still ahead of us.

      I want more soft moments with you: tea in the evening, ice cream on a random day, laughing at something tiny, or simply sitting in the same room feeling close.

      I’m working hard to grow into someone you can be proud of, and I hope you’ll be right beside me to see it. A big part of whoever I become will have started with you.

      I love you, Mummy. Today, tomorrow, and always.

      Your daughter,
      Jiya 🫂

      P.S. Can we have a hug and a cup of tea soon? ☕🤍
